newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle Micro gets trade debt moratorium.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle Micro gets trade debt moratorium.

text.p: Pinnacle Micro Inc said Friday a committee of trade creditors had agreed to an initial 60-day moratorium on the payment of the company's trade debt.
Pinnacle said the committee represents more than half of the company's trade debt.
It said it has been having difficulty paying its trade debt on a timely basis and has been seeking the cooperation of its creditors in a restructuring of the debt.

Pinnacle said it has engaged the investment banking firm Houlihan, Lokey, Howard & Zukin to assist it in evaluating alternatives, including possibly locating a financial or industry partner or other transaction.
No such transaction is currently pending, Pinnacle said.
The company has also engaged the consulting firm Kibel, Green Inc, a turnaround and management consulting firm, as well as the law firm Lobel & Opera to assist it in dealing with creditors.
